knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A cable with damaged insulation is unsafe. It is removed from use and the item and action are recorded.
The WA hairdressing guideline requires mobile operators to send wastewater into the sewer and keep it out of stormwater.

The lesson says to set electrical equipment on a dry surface away from the sink and never put a plugged-in appliance into water. Wet equipment should not be switched on until a competent person has checked it.

practicalCriteria: Assessor observes the candidate check the outlet, cable and load before plugging in, and record the check
Assessor observes the candidate identify a damaged cable in a simulated set-up, remove it from use and record it
Assessor observes the candidate plan and carry out the wastewater disposal for a simulated visit where the sewer connection cannot be checked
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Set-up checklist for the simulated visit
Record of the removed item, if any, with the action
Wastewater disposal record with the location used
stopWorkCriteria: A damaged cable or appliance is used
Electrical equipment is used near standing water
Wastewater is tipped into a stormwater drain
